snippet.title: Ambrosia Sky 🪐 | Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Ambrosia Sky is a first-person action game about cleaning up after a deadly, sentient contamination. Take on the role of Dalia as she returns to her home in the outer rings of Saturn to investigate strange deaths and the alien contamination that caused them. 

Ambrosia Sky is Soft Rains' first game. Soft Rains is a game studio dedicated to delivering world-class development experience to our work, encompassing worldbuilding, memorable storytelling, immersive gameplay, and art.

🪐 Wishlist Ambrosia Sky on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3580160/Ambrosia_Sky/
